description: Thresholds for the Xerberus common-cause gate

min_venues_for_shared_node.description: How many of the book's venues must share an upstream node before any limit applies to it. The reference uses 2.

shared_node_types.description: Xerberus node types the limits apply to (for example token, protocol, oracle, gov, irm), case-insensitive. An empty list applies them to every type.

max_shared_exposure_usd.description: Maximum USD of the book's venue exposure that may sit behind one shared upstream node. The reference uses 5000000.

max_shared_exposure_pct_of_book.description: Maximum share (percent) of the book's venue exposure that may sit behind one shared upstream node. The reference uses 40.

max_shared_expected_loss_share.description: Maximum Xerberus expected loss share (loss rate in [0, 1]) of a shared upstream node. The reference uses 0.05.

forbidden_shared_nodes.description: Xerberus node ids (for example protocol:lido or oracle:0x...) that the book's venues must not share. Case-insensitive. An empty list disables the check.

material_venue_usd.description: Exposure (USD) at or above which a venue Xerberus could not place in its graph counts as material.

deny_on_unresolved.description: When true, deny if any material venue is unresolved in the Xerberus graph.

deny_on_truncated.description: When true, deny if Xerberus returned fewer shared nodes than it found.

min_venues_compared.description: Minimum number of venues (above the $100 dust floor) the analysis must compare. Cross-venue analysis needs at least 2.

deny_on_stale.description: When true, deny whenever Xerberus flags its data window as stale (is_stale).

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Xerberus data window, measured at evaluation time.

require_intent_party_in_wallets.description: When true, deny unless the intent's sender or target is one of the analysed wallets.
